content.user_title: Generate Music with ACE Step on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Teams need fast music drafts, repairs, and extensions without complex audio tooling. This skill guides ACE Step generation, inpainting, and outpainting through the RunComfy CLI.
actual_capabilities: Routes text-to-audio requests to ACE Step or ACE Step 1.5 based on language and quality needs.
Builds RunComfy CLI inputs for tag-driven instrumental or vocal music up to 240 seconds.
Guides audio inpainting with start and end times for replacing a section.
Guides audio outpainting to add intros, outros, or both around an existing track.
Explains seeds, lyrics markers, costs, exit codes, and output directory behavior.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy login or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.
Uses remote RunComfy services, so generated audio depends on network access and service availability.
Cannot verify copyright ownership for user-provided lyrics or source audio.
Each ACE Step call is limited to 240 seconds of generated or edited audio.

use_cases.title: Create Game Music Loops
use_cases.description: Generate low-cost instrumental drafts with tags for mood, tempo, instruments, and loop-friendly structure.

use_cases.title: Localize Vocal Campaign Tracks
use_cases.description: Use ACE Step 1.5 with structured lyrics to create language-specific versions of the same song idea.

use_cases.title: Repair or Extend Existing Audio
use_cases.description: Replace a timed section with inpainting or add a new intro and outro with outpainting.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Instrumental Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step to make a 60 second instrumental track. Style: [genre, mood, instruments, BPM]. Save the result in ./out.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Structured Vocal Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step 1.5 to create a vocal song in [language]. Include verse, chorus, bridge, and outro sections.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Song Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step audio-inpaint to replace seconds [start] to [end] in this track: [audio URL]. Match this style: [tags].

prompt_templates.title: Extend and Iterate a Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ACE Step audio-outpaint to add [seconds] before and [seconds] after this track: [audio URL]. Keep the arrangement coherent.

output_examples.input: Create a 90 second lo-fi instrumental with soft drums, rhodes piano, vinyl texture, and no vocals.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects ACE Step base, prepares detailed tags, requests an instrumental output, and saves the generated audio to the output folder.

output_examples.input: Replace seconds 20 to 40 of my song with a softer piano bridge.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects audio-inpaint, keeps the edit window focused, matches the surrounding style, and regenerates only that section.

output_examples.input: Extend my 30 second hook with a short intro and a longer fade-out.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects audio-outpaint, adds audio before and after the source, and uses tags that describe the new sections.

best_practices: Provide genre, mood, instruments, vocal style, and BPM in the tags.
Use section markers for lyrics and keep line length consistent.
Use fixed seeds for repeatable drafts and random seeds for exploration.
anti_patterns: Requesting vague music such as only "make something cool".
Using copyrighted lyrics or source audio without permission.
Trying to edit an untimed section without start and end seconds.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create, repair, and extend music with ACE Step models through the RunComfy CLI.

faq.question: Do I need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires the RunComfy CLI and either login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN environment variable.

faq.question: Which ACE Step endpoint should I use?
faq.answer: Use base text-to-audio for fast drafts, ACE Step 1.5 for multilingual vocals, inpaint for repairs, and outpaint for extensions.

faq.question: Can it edit existing audio?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide timed inpainting for section replacement and outpainting for intro or outro extension.

faq.question: How long can one output be?
faq.answer: ACE Step calls can generate or edit up to 240 seconds per request.

faq.question: Where are RunComfy tokens stored?
faq.answer: The CLI documents token storage under ~/.config/runcomfy/token.json with mode 0600. CI can use RUNCOMFY_TOKEN instead.
